review_candidates.title: Devops Senior Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Maintain DevOps infrastructure, including servers, storage, and networking, ensuring the reliability and performance of it. Working closely with software engineers, QA, and systems engineers to understand requirements and prototype, architect, implement, operate, and update DevOps solutions accordingly. Full responsibility of migration and upgrading to new releases to ensure smooth transitions and continued functionality. Maintaining the availability of the applications and their hosted servers
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Working closely with software engineers, QA, and systems engineers to understand requirements and prototype, architect, implement, operate, and update DevOps solutions accordingly. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in computer science or relevant fields 4 years of experience in DevOps Strong experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, and microservices architecture. Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, etc.), Infrastructure as Code (IaC), SonarQube, ELK, and automation using scripting languages (Python, Bash, Groovy, JavaScript). Proficient with Jira, GitHub, and version control workflows.
